description: Candle Creek Cross Country Ski Trail system offers 25 km of groomed trails. Day lodge facility. Trail fees are charged throughout the winter operating season.
directions: From Clearwater, take Highway 5 east for 2km and turn left (north) onto Candle Creek Road. Proceed for 2.5km and turn right onto Barber Road, continuing 3km more to the parking area and trailhead.

stats.Activity Details: Hiking, Ski Touring, Picnicking, Viewing, Snowshoeing, Skiing

title: Candle Creek XC Ski
